claim_ceiling: Synthetic time-indexed utility feasibility semantics only; no plant meter data, resource savings or production performance is claimed.

cases.purpose: Complete operation utility profile fits within a known time-window capacity.
Concurrent operation peak demand exceeds the electrical capacity envelope.
A scheduled operation without a utility profile is not assumed to consume zero.
Known positive demand cannot be qualified against an unknown capacity meter.
Positive demand outside the time coverage of all envelopes fails closed.
Setup utility consumption is counted concurrently with the scheduled production operation.
Overlapping capacity envelopes and duplicate metric demand entries are rejected.
Sequential operations that touch at a half-open boundary do not overlap or sum their peaks.
